question: Seven boxes, L, M, N, O, Q, R and S, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Q is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between Q and S. R is kept at one of the positions below Q. Only N is kept between S and L. Only two boxes are kept between L and O. How many boxes are kept between M and S?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Q is kept second from the bottom.

Only three boxes are kept between Q and S.

R is kept at one of the positions below Q.

Only N is kept between S and L.

Only two boxes are kept between L and O.
